# Archive test fixtures

- `rar5-multiple-files.rar` — RAR5 archive holding three 4 KiB entries
  (`test1.bin`/`test2.bin`/`test3.bin`, 1656 bytes on disk). 7-Zip
  cannot *create* rar archives, so the sample is vendored: decoded from
  libarchive's test suite
  (`libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_multiple_files.rar.uu`,
  BSD-2-Clause licensed test data, generated by libarchive's rar5
  writer). SHA-256:
  `65305723965a55a89b7e120d54807c6ae30b69532712aa20d3934296799e923b`.
  Verify with `7z l -slt -ba` — entries must list with their sizes.
